metadata.title: Bump typepy from 1.3.2 to 2.0.0
metadata.body:
Bumps [typepy](https://github.com/thombashi/typepy) from 1.3.2 to 2.0.0.
Release notes

Sourced from typepy's releases.

v2.0.0

What's Changed

  • Replace pytz with ZoneInfo + misc datetime fixes by @​JYOuyang in thombashi/typepy#13

New Contributors

  • @​JYOuyang made their first contribution in thombashi/typepy#13

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thombashi/typepy/compare/v1.3.5...v2.0.0

v1.3.5

What's Changed

  • Bump the actions-dependencies group across 1 directory with 6 updates by @​dependabot[bot] in thombashi/typepy#9
  • Fixed an invalid input handle for DateTimeConverter by @​thombashi in thombashi/typepy#10
  • Add support for Python 3.14 by @​thombashi in thombashi/typepy#11
  • Fix logic issues in type checking and conversion functions by @​thombashi in thombashi/typepy#12

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thombashi/typepy/compare/v1.3.4...v1.3.5

v1.3.4

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thombashi/typepy/compare/v1.3.3...v1.3.4

v1.3.3

What's Changed

  • Replace deprecated abctractproperty
  • Drop support for Python 3.7/3.8
  • Add support for Python 3.13
  • Add GitHub Actions workflow for building and publishing to PyPI
  • Update copyright years
  • Bump actions/setup-python from 4 to 5 by @​dependabot in thombashi/typepy#4

New Contributors

  • @​dependabot made their first contribution in thombashi/typepy#4

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thombashi/typepy/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3

Commits
  • 2d7ed70 Bump version to 2.0.0
  • f65a5b3 Merge pull request #13 from JYOuyang/jyo-tz
  • dd5f448 setup.py: PEP 508 env marker to install tzdata if on Windows.
  • c702aa0 Replace pytz with ZoneInfo + misc datetime fixes
  • 92958dc Bump version to 1.3.5
  • d514e76 Merge pull request #12 from thombashi/fix-logic-issues
  • 4692c23 Fix logic issues in type checking and conversion functions
  • de7043e Merge pull request #11 from thombashi/add-py314
  • 998a550 Add support for Python 3.14
  • 8d4fad5 Add permissions section to GitHub Actions workflow
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

[![Dependabot compatibility score](https://dependabot-badges.githubapp.com/badges/compatibility_score?dependency-name=typepy&package-manager=pip&previous-version=1.3.2&new-version=2.0.0)](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-security-vulnerabilities/about-dependabot-security-updates#about-compatibility-scores) Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself. You can also trigger a rebase manually by commenting `@dependabot rebase`. [//]: # (dependabot-automerge-start) [//]: # (dependabot-automerge-end) ---

You can trigger Dependabot actions by commenting on this PR: - `@dependabot rebase` will rebase this PR - `@dependabot recreate` will recreate this PR, overwriting any edits that have been made to it - `@dependabot show ignore conditions` will show all of the ignore conditions of the specified dependency - `@dependabot ignore this major version` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this major version (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself) - `@dependabot ignore this minor version` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this minor version (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself) - `@dependabot ignore this dependency` will close this PR and stop Dependabot creating any more for this dependency (unless you reopen the PR or upgrade to it yourself)
